D10.FUNCTION: Persistence of ETH residual after orthogonalizing to contemporaneous BTC; not rolling correlation; not raw lead-lag
D10.KNOWN_PRIOR_EXPOSURE: D4 rolling corr; D4 lead-lag null class; MARKET-05 additive ETH MAE; H03/B2-03 BTC impulse continuation
D10.MARKET_RELATIONSHIP: Indirect. Persistent ETH-specific residual would at most motivate later residual-structure confirmation. Not an ETH overlay product and not MARKET-05 salvage.

D10.PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION: OPTION A no-intercept OLS. beta_t = sum(x*y)/sum(x^2) using exactly the previous 720 valid completed hours strictly before event hour t (current t excluded). e_t = r_eth_t - beta_t * r_btc_t. e_t_plus_1_fixed_beta = r_eth_{t+1} - beta_t * r_btc_{t+1}. PRIMARY_TARGET = sign(e_t) * e_t_plus_1_fixed_beta. Do not recompute beta at t+1. Do not allow event hour t into the beta used by the target. Do not fit an intercept and then drop it. Event: |e_t| > P90(previous 720 valid |e|), current excluded, strict >. Ineligible if beta_t undefined or t+1 hour missing/protected.

not one-year driven
no hidden beta-window or P-threshold search
not MARKET-05 24h MAE

D10.SMALL_SEARCH_SURFACE: One 720h trailing OLS beta strictly before t, one P90 |e_t| event, one next-hour residual that reuses beta_t, one frozen YEAR x sign(e_t) x |r_btc_t| bucket match plus small-|e_t| controls. No rolling-corr. No raw lead-lag. No 24h MAE. No beta re-estimation at t+1.

D9.PRIMARY_TARGET_DEFINITION: If TOTAL_CLOSURE = -sign(D)*(rp-rs) > 0 then PERP_RESOLUTION_SHARE = (-sign(D)*rp)/TOTAL_CLOSURE, unclipped; else INELIGIBLE. SHARE=0.5 means equal signed contribution to net closure. SHARE>0.5 means perp contributed more net closure than spot. SHARE<0.5 means spot contributed more net closure than perp. SHARE>0 alone does not mean perp contributed more. Values <0 or >1 are legal when one venue opposes closure and the other over-compensates. Do not clip or winsorize. Synchronous 5m closes cannot establish PRICE_DISCOVERY_LEADERSHIP, CAUSAL_LEADERSHIP, or WHICH_VENUE_MOVED_FIRST.
